mission_02: Great work! You have successfully implemented text data augmentation techniques including synonym replacement and random word swapping. You learned how to create variations of text samples while preserving their labels and general meaning. Text augmentation is essential for NLP tasks where labeled data is scarce. While this mission used a simple synonym dictionary, production systems use word embeddings (Word2Vec, GloVe) or pre-trained language models (BERT) for more context-aware synonym selection. Libraries like nlpaug and nlpaug provide comprehensive text augmentation pipelines for production use.
